$comment: Prompt manifest for the hand-generated art (spec section 8). Each asset's prompt is self-contained so a single file can be regenerated later without reconstructing context. Generated by hand in the ChatGPT app; nothing here is called at runtime.

generation.backgroundException: icon.png is generated on a solid background; see its note.
generation.postProcess: Downscale every file except icon.png to 512x512, then run through an optimiser (oxipng or ImageOptim). These ship to phones over someone's flat wifi.

workflow: 1. Generate chip-01 first and keep regenerating until the style is right. It is the anchor for the whole set.

2. For chip-02 onward, attach chip-01 as a reference image and append this line to the prompt: 'Keep the same chip proportions, the same outline weight, the same two-tone cel shading and the same face style as the reference. Change only the body colour and the accessory. Do not redesign the character.'
3. Do the same for winner, broke and empty, which are the same character in different moods.
4. rebuy-burst and icon have no face and need no reference.
5. Save each file under public/art/ using the exact filename in this manifest. The filenames are load-bearing: avatar_key maps straight onto them.
sharedStyle: Flat vector, thick rounded outlines of even weight, soft cel shading in two tones, a limited palette of deep green felt, warm cream, warm red and antique gold, playful children's-book character energy. Every avatar differs by chip colour plus exactly one accessory, so the set reads as a family.

assets.chipColour: deep green felt green with a cream rim
assets.accessory: a pair of narrow black sunglasses
assets.prompt:
Subject: a single round poker chip character seen face-on, its body deep green felt green with a cream rim, with the usual evenly spaced rectangular edge notches around the rim. A simple cartoon face sits centred on the chip face: two round black eyes and a small friendly closed smile. It has short rounded stub arms and stub legs. It wears a pair of narrow black sunglasses, and that is its only accessory.

Style: flat vector illustration, thick rounded outlines of even weight, soft cel shading in two tones only, limited palette of deep green felt, warm cream, warm red and antique gold. Playful children's-book character energy, friendly and rounded. No gradients, no photographic texture, no realism.

Composition: square 1:1 frame, a single subject centred, the whole shape visible with an even margin on all four sides, front-facing, nothing cropped.

Use case: a small app avatar rendered at 96 pixels on a phone, so the shapes must stay bold and readable when tiny.

Constraints: transparent background, crisp silhouette, clean edges, no halos, no fringing. No text, letters, numbers or lettering of any kind anywhere in the image. No casino branding or real-world brand marks, no playing-card suits or face-card artwork, no resemblance to any real person. No drop shadow, no background scenery, no border, no frame.

assets.note: The only asset with a solid background rather than a transparent one. Spec 8.3 permits 'transparent or plain'; a transparent app icon renders badly on a phone home screen, and iOS flattens it onto white. Generate at 1024x1024 and keep it there.
assets.prompt:
Subject: an app icon. A single warm cream poker chip seen face-on, centred, with the usual evenly spaced rectangular edge notches around its rim and a plain uninterrupted middle. No face, no character, no accessory. It sits on a solid deep green felt green background that fills the whole square.

Style: flat vector illustration, thick rounded outlines of even weight, soft cel shading in two tones only, limited palette of deep green felt, warm cream, warm red and antique gold. Playful children's-book character energy, friendly and rounded. No gradients, no photographic texture, no realism.

Composition: square 1:1 frame, the chip centred and occupying roughly 62 percent of the width, leaving generous even padding on all four sides so it survives being masked into a circle or a squircle.

Use case: a phone home screen app icon, rendered as small as 48 pixels, so it must be one bold unmistakable shape.

Constraints: solid deep green background filling the entire square, no transparency. No text, letters, numbers or lettering of any kind. No casino branding or real-world brand marks, no playing-card suits or face-card artwork. No drop shadow, no border, no frame, no glare or gloss highlight.
